reported_results.text: As shown by the statistical analyses, the mean survival rate was significantly increased by 24.2% in the FDPAL-treated group as compared to that of control (Fig 3D).

The results showed that 10mM FDPAL up-regulated SOD-3::GFP expression by 116.06% in transgenic CF1553 (Fig 5A), indicating that FDPAL could enhance the expression of SOD-3 under oxidative stress in C. elegans.

numbers.text: The cells were seeded in 96-well plates at a final concentration of 8 × 103 cells per well and incubated with FDPAL at various concentrations (0, 0.1, 0.2, 1, 2, 10, 20 mM) for 12 h prior to the addition of 500 μM H2O2.
For the ROS test under oxidative stress, two-day-old adult worms were treated with 300 μM juglone for 1 h and were then transferred to plates with or without FDPAL (10 mM).
A series of reactions with a final FDPAL concentration of 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 1 and 2 mM were set up and absorbance was measured at 325 nm.
Pyrogallol self-oxidation assay The in vitro superoxide anion-scavenging characteristic of FDPAL was measured using a pyrogallol autoxidation system with modifications [21].
with a final FDPAL concentration 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 1 and 2 mM were set up and absorbance was measured at 550 nm.
As shown by the statistical analyses, the mean survival rate was significantly increased by 24.2% in the FDPAL-treated group as compared to that of control (Fig 3D).

The results showed that 10mM FDPAL up-regulated SOD-3::GFP expression by 116.06% in transgenic CF1553 (Fig 5A), indicating that FDPAL could enhance the expression of SOD-3 under oxidative stress in C. elegans.
